Game Overview

In Flying Fox, the core idea is straightforward: guide the spirited fox through a sky of challenges. Soar past birds, bats, and dinosaurs while collecting glittering rings for points. Stay vigilant and agile to keep flying without tumbling down. A thrilling test of reflexes awaits!

How to Play

Each session of Flying Fox follows a consistent rhythm. Guide the spirited fox through a sky of challenges. Soar past birds, bats, and dinosaurs while collecting glittering rings for points. Stay vigilant and agile to keep flying without tumbling down. A thrilling test of reflexes awaits!
